require 'optparse'

class WordCounter
  def initialize(input)
    @input = input
  end

  def count_words_and_lines
    lines = @input.split("\n")
    word_count = lines.map { |line| line.split(/\s+/).size }.sum
    { words: word_count, lines: lines.size }
  end
end

def main
  parser = OptionParser.new
  parser.banner = "Usage: word-counter.rb [options] FILE"
  options = {}

  parser.on("-h", "--help", "Prints this help message") do
    puts parser
    exit
  end

  begin
    parser.parse!
  rescue OptionParser::InvalidOption => e
    puts e.message
    puts parser
    exit 1
  end

  if ARGV.empty?
    puts "Error: No input file provided."
    puts parser
    exit 1
  end

  input_file = ARGV[0]
  unless File.exist?(input_file)
    puts "Error: File '#{input_file}' not found."
    exit 1
  end

  content = File.read(input_file)
  counter = WordCounter.new(content)
  result = counter.count_words_and_lines
  puts "Word Count: #{result[:words]}"
  puts "Line Count: #{result[:lines]}"
end

main if __FILE__ == $0

module Stats
  def self.process_file(path)
    File.open(path, 'r') do |file|
      lines = file.readlines
      word_count = 0
      lines.each do |line|
        words = line.split(/\s+/)
        word_count += words.count
      end
      puts "File: #{path}"
      puts "Lines: #{lines.size}"
      puts "Words: #{word_count}"
    end
  end
end

def count_words_and_lines(file_path)
  begin
    lines = File.readlines(file_path)
    word_count = lines.map { |line| line.split.size }.sum
    { words: word_count, lines: lines.size }
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error reading file: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  if ARGV.length != 1
    puts 'Usage: ruby cli.rb <file-path>'
    exit 1
  end

  file_path = ARGV[0]
  result = count_words_and_lines(file_path)
  if result
    puts "Words: #{result[:words]}, Lines: #{result[:lines]}"
  end
end
